REPORT zmcp_dbg_demo.

* ZMCP_DBG_DEMO - centrepiece of the debugger test scenario.
*
* Reads ZMCP_DBG_ITEM (filled deterministically by ZMCP_DBG_FILL),
* loops over the 15 rows computing a line value per row via a local
* class method call (a real call frame to step into/out of), aggregates
* per-category totals into a second internal table, then computes an
* average and the highest-value category, and WRITEs everything out in
* a format that is easy to assert on.
*
* See scripts/fixtures/debug/README.md for the exact expected output
* and the hand-computed arithmetic behind it.

" A RETURNING parameter must be FULLY typed - `TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2`
" inline in the signature is rejected by the compiler ("A RETURNING parameter
" must be fully typed."), so the amount type is named once here and reused.
TYPES ty_amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.

CLASS lcl_calc DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    " Computes one line's value (quantity * unit price). Called once per
    " loop iteration in the main flow below - this is the call frame the
    " debugger scenario exists to exercise.
    CLASS-METHODS line_value
      IMPORTING iv_qty          TYPE i
                iv_price        TYPE zmcp_dbg_item-unit_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE ty_amount.

    " Formats a packed amount as a locale-independent "123.45" string by
    " working entirely in integer cents, so the WRITE output below never
    " depends on the logged-on user's decimal-notation setting.
    CLASS-METHODS format_amount
      IMPORTING iv_amount      TYPE p
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD line_value.
    DATA lv_raw TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
    " DEBUG STOP M: inside lcl_calc=>line_value - own locals iv_qty, iv_price, lv_raw
    IF iv_qty <= 0.
      rv_total = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    lv_raw   = iv_qty * iv_price.
    rv_total = lv_raw.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_amount.
    DATA: lv_cents TYPE i,
          lv_int   TYPE i,
          lv_frac  TYPE i.
    lv_cents = round( val = iv_amount * 100 dec = 0 ).
    lv_int   = lv_cents DIV 100.
    lv_frac  = lv_cents MOD 100.
    rv_text  = |{ lv_int }.{ lv_frac WIDTH = 2 PAD = '0' ALIGN = RIGHT }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cat_total,
         category TYPE zmcp_dbg_item-category,
         total    TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
         cnt      TYPE i,
       END OF ty_cat_total,
       ty_cat_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cat_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

DATA: lt_cat_totals   TYPE ty_cat_totals,
      lv_grand_total  TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2 VALUE 0,
      lv_counter      TYPE i VALUE 0,
      lv_average      TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 4,
      lv_top_category TYPE zmcp_dbg_item-category,
      lv_top_total    TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2 VALUE 0.

" An explicit event block is REQUIRED here: once a processing block
" (CLASS ... IMPLEMENTATION above) has been opened and closed, later top-level
" statements no longer fall into the implicit START-OF-SELECTION and the
" compiler rejects them with "Statement is not accessible."
START-OF-SELECTION.

SELECT * FROM zmcp_dbg_item INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_items) ORDER BY item_id.
" DEBUG STOP 1: after SELECT, lt_items populated (15 rows expected)

LOOP AT lt_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
  lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.

  DATA(lv_line_total) = lcl_calc=>line_value(
    iv_qty   = ls_item-quantity
    iv_price = ls_item-unit_price ).
  " DEBUG STOP 2: back in the loop, right after the method call returns -
  " lv_line_total now holds quantity * unit_price for the current row

  lv_grand_total = lv_grand_total + lv_line_total.

  ASSIGN lt_cat_totals[ category = ls_item-category ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_cat>).
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    APPEND VALUE #( category = ls_item-category total = 0 cnt = 0 ) TO lt_cat_totals.
    ASSIGN lt_cat_totals[ category = ls_item-category ] TO <ls_cat>.
  ENDIF.
  <ls_cat>-total = <ls_cat>-total + lv_line_total.
  <ls_cat>-cnt   = <ls_cat>-cnt + 1.
  " DEBUG STOP 3: end of loop body - lt_cat_totals has a fresh running total
  " for ls_item-category, visible changing on every iteration
ENDLOOP.

lv_average = lv_grand_total / lv_counter.

LOOP AT lt_cat_totals INTO DATA(ls_cat_scan).
  IF ls_cat_scan-total > lv_top_total.
    lv_top_total    = ls_cat_scan-total.
    lv_top_category = ls_cat_scan-category.
  ENDIF.
ENDLOOP.
" DEBUG STOP 4: after both post-loop computations - lv_average and
" lv_top_category/lv_top_total are final

WRITE: / 'ZMCP_DBG_DEMO RESULTS'.
WRITE: / |ITEMS={ lv_counter }|.

LOOP AT lt_cat_totals INTO DATA(ls_cat_out).
  WRITE: / |CAT={ ls_cat_out-category } COUNT={ ls_cat_out-cnt } TOTAL={ lcl_calc=>format_amount( ls_cat_out-total ) }|.
ENDLOOP.

WRITE: / |GRAND_TOTAL={ lcl_calc=>format_amount( lv_grand_total ) }|.
WRITE: / |AVERAGE={ lcl_calc=>format_amount( lv_average ) }|.
WRITE: / |TOP_CATEGORY={ lv_top_category } TOP_TOTAL={ lcl_calc=>format_amount( lv_top_total ) }|.
